caption:
Juniors stay quiet because they don't want to look slow. Seniors would much rather spend 10 minutes unblocking you than find out on day 3.

Writing down what you tried does two things. Often you spot the answer while writing it. If not, your senior can skip the obvious questions and help you faster.

Template: "I'm trying to X. I expected Y, I got Z. I've tried A and B."

Save this for your first job.

Taking 2 days without asking anyone: the actual problem.
